Add the AI sample study

Source: R/ai_sample.R
create_ai_sample_study.Rd

Makes the sample for the AI tab as a study of its own, without the app: the same as the app's New study dialog with The sample for the AI tab. 'tflspec' writes the sample's materials (a TOC, shells, ADaM data, an ADaM spec and a SAP; no answers) into samples/ai-sample under the home; the study root/<study_id> is then made over the sample's ADaM (tflspec::tfl_ai_study_init()) with the TOC, the shells and the ADaM spec in its docs/, the ADaM in data/adam/ and the SAP in ai/docs/, and registered. Everything in it is fictional.

Usage

create_ai_sample_study(
  root = studies_root(home),
  study_id = "DMY-001",
  title = "Example Pharma DMY-001 (fictional)",
  home = tflplanner_home()
)

Arguments

root

The studies folder (default: where new studies go, see setup_tflplanner()).

study_id

The new study's ID (default DMY-001).

title

The study's title.

home

tflplanner's home.

Value

list(study, kit), invisibly: the study, and the kit of paths described above.

Details

The returned kit holds the paths of the materials inside the study: toc, shells, adam, adam_spec and docs. These are what tflspec::tfl_ai_prepare() takes (toc, shells, adam, adam_spec and docs), the same fields the AI tab's step 1 is filled with.

Examples

# a home in the temporary folder: used in this R session only, nothing
# is written to your settings
old <- options(tflplanner.home = NULL)
setup_tflplanner(home = tempfile("tflplanner-home"))
#> The home /tmp/RtmpTnNlOL/tflplanner-home1b18769c53d4 is in the temporary folder: it is used in this R session only, not remembered for later ones.
#> tflplanner home: /tmp/RtmpTnNlOL/tflplanner-home1b18769c53d4
#> new studies go to: /tmp/RtmpTnNlOL/tflplanner-home1b18769c53d4/studies
# \donttest{
# (a few seconds: it writes the sample's materials and the study)
made <- create_ai_sample_study()
kit <- made$kit
# then, as the AI tab's step 1 does:
p <- tflspec::tfl_ai_prepare(made$study$path, toc = kit$toc, adam = kit$adam,
                             shells = kit$shells, adam_spec = kit$adam_spec,
                             docs = kit$docs, dry_run = TRUE)
# }
options(old)
